shots.purpose: REPLACE: the unique story, proof or emotional job of this shot
shots.action: REPLACE: the visible action and change inside the frame
shots.start_state: REPLACE: exact incoming subject, product and environment state
shots.end_state: REPLACE: exact outgoing state that the next shot inherits

attention.path: REPLACE: what transfers attention and in which order
attention.end: REPLACE: where attention lands at the cut

camera.reason: REPLACE: why this camera behavior serves the beat
camera.start_composition: REPLACE: size, angle, depth and focal arrangement
camera.end_composition: REPLACE: final size, angle, depth and focal arrangement
camera.velocity: REPLACE: acceleration, stillness, deceleration and settling behavior

lighting.motivation: REPLACE: credible or deliberately stylized source logic
lighting.subject_priority: REPLACE: what must remain readable and what may fall away
lighting.background: REPLACE: depth, texture and separation behavior
lighting.exposure_risk: REPLACE: highlights, shadows, reflections or color at risk

continuity.incoming: REPLACE: state and direction inherited from the prior shot
continuity.outgoing: REPLACE: state and direction delivered to the next shot
continuity.screen_direction: REPLACE: action line, gaze and movement direction

sound.foreground: REPLACE: voice, foley or designed event carrying this beat
sound.perspective: REPLACE: audible distance, space and material behavior
sound.transition: REPLACE: sound motivation into and out of the shot

source.description: REPLACE: exact asset or generation/build plan

acceptance.check: REPLACE: one observable fact that must pass
acceptance.evidence: REPLACE: frame range, timestamp, reference or listening evidence
